verdict.rationale: AMD's Ryzen AI docs describe an official command-line tool, xrt-smi, for monitoring and managing the integrated NPU. The official tooling for AI workflows (Lemonade SDK, GAIA, OGA) is documented through Python/C++ APIs and a server interface, not as a CLI. That leaves only a hardware-management CLI rather than a CLI for running or managing AI workloads. Missing for 10: evidence of an official CLI for model download/run/serve or agent workflows, depth of CLI documentation beyond a one-line description, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
